title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Integrated Towel Bar Solid Brass | Golden Yellow | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized surface space with a wall mount glass shelf featuring an integrated towel bar and thick tempered glass in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. This bathroom vanity shelf helps keep small items accessible while providing a convenient towel bar below.

Highlights:
- Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with a beveled edge
- Solid brass hardware for strength
- Coordinates with the Waverly Place Collection and other versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Glass shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5 Inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available for transitional bathroom hardware
